title: The self-improvement loop most people never find
description:
Most self-improvement is single-layer. There's a deeper game.
Improving how you improve — that's the recursive move. #Shorts #selfimprovement #habits #personaldevelopment
hook_visual: White text on dark background fills the screen in the first second: 'Most self-improvement is a treadmill.' — cut immediately to the speaker or to a treadmill running in place. High contrast, motion within 2 seconds to stop the scroll.
end_screen_cta: Ask directly to camera: 'Which of the five loops do you think you're missing?' — hold for two seconds, then subscribe prompt overlay.
